method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 109, compilation date 19 September 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 87, 2026), register id C2026C00429, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00819.txt. No regulations deposited: the s 12BC(3)(a)(ii) greater amount and the penalty unit value (Crimes Act 1914 s 4AA) are inputs

scope: ss 11(1), 12A(1)-(2) (where ASIC's role comes from); s 12BAB(1), (1AA), (7), (9) (financial service); s 12BC(1)-(3) (consumer, $40,000 or a greater prescribed amount; small business); ss 12BF(1), (3)-(4), 12BG(1), (4), 12BI(1)(a)-(c), (f), 12BL(1) (unfair terms in consumer and small business contracts: $5,000,000 upfront price, 100 persons, $10,000,000 turnover; company constitutions excluded); s 12CB (unconscionable conduct); ss 12BB(1)-(2), 12DA(1), (1A) (misleading conduct); s 12DJ (harassment and coercion); s 12DL(1)-(2) (unsolicited cards); ss 12DM(1), 12DMA (unsolicited services); ss 12EB(1), 12EC, 12ED(1)-(3) (implied warranties); s 12GF(1), (1B), (2) (damages, 6 years); ss 12GB(1), 12GBA(6), 12GBCA(1)-(2) (offences and civil penalties); Part 3 ss 13(1), (6), 19, 23(1), 30(1), 63(1), (5), 68 (ASIC examination and production)
seat: the consumer of financial services, and the company founder as far as the registration event needs
